items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: for me to play with this band -- Woody Herman, Tommy Dorsey, every band that came out to Fairyland, I had to get up there and play with them.

ctx.x: Charlie Barnet. So -- and having won that citation, you know, for -- DownBeat thing -- and then every time they had a show or something, every band that came in town, Jay and I and Johnny Tumino would have to go out there for me to play with this band -- Woody Herman, Tommy Dorsey, every band that came out to Fairyland, I had to get up there and play with them.
It was sort of publicity for you too.
